svg.text: Reuse does not track spending: across a thousand-fold spread in cost per download, the award explains none of it
89 datasets naming an NIH project number that resolves to a single-project research grant. Median award $3.1m, median 43 downloads, median $57,010 each. 3 zeros sit in the gutter.

OpenNeuro GraphQL and NIH RePORTER v2, both keyless, fetched 2026-09-24. 443 of 1,891 datasets name a grant; 143 carry a parseable NIH core project number; 89 resolve to a
single-project research grant, 86 of them with at least one download. CAVEAT: the award funds a project, not a dataset, so every figure here is an upper bound -- and three
datasets spell the activity code with a letter O, which the parser rewrites.
